curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the two required coverages, their minimums, what happens after a lapse, and the higher financial-responsibility tiers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each coverage rule and lapse penalty with contrasts on the responsibility tiers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on minimum coverage, lapse consequences and which tier applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the teen driving hours, the list of license crimes, and disabled parking permits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each curfew window, license crime and permit rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on teen driving hours and permit misuse.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define DUI and implied consent, then the refusal penalties, the first to third conviction ladder and the under-twenty-one rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards per conviction level and refusal rule, with contrasts on how penalties climb.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions matching penalties to the conviction number and the alcohol level.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach litter and school bus penalties, then belt and child restraint rules and their exemptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty and restraint rule with contrasts on bus passing outcomes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on bus passing penalties and who must be belted or seated.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover speed limits and fines, crash-course rules, point suspensions and the point table.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each fine, crash rule and point value with contrasts on thresholds.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on point values and the totals that trigger suspension.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate suspension, revocation and cancellation, then the review offices and the ten-day hearing window.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the grounds of each action and the hearing rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions asking which action fits a described ground.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec03-m01..sec03-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
